keyEvents.text: Goal! Rennes 0, Lille 1. Soriba Diaoune (Lille) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Rennes 1, Lille 1. Boulaye Dia (Rennes) right footed shot from very close range to the top right corner. Assisted by Abdelhamid Aït Boudlal following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Tanguy Nianzou (Lille).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Calvin Verdonk (Lille) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Mahdi Camara (Rennes).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Lille. Romain Perraud replaces Calvin Verdonk.
Substitution, Lille. Maurits Kjærgaard replaces Nabil Bentaleb.
Substitution, Rennes. Mousa Al Tamari replaces Eliezer Mayenda.
Goal! Rennes 1, Lille 2. Nathan Ngoy (Lille) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Soriba Diaoune.
Maurits Kjærgaard (Lille) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lille. Dilane Bakwa replaces Ethan Mbappé.
Substitution, Rennes. Issa Soumaré replaces Boulaye Dia.
Substitution, Rennes. Djaoui Cissé replaces Mahdi Camara.
Substitution, Rennes. Ludovic Blas replaces Adrien Thomasson.
Nathan Ngoy (Lille) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Rennes. Sebastian Szymanski replaces Gonçalo Oliveira.
Substitution, Lille. Isaac Cossier replaces Ngal'ayel Mukau.
Substitution, Lille. Olivier Giroud replaces Hákon Haraldsson.
Second Half ends, Rennes 1, Lille 2.
